meta.title: TradeNova - Webflow HTML website template
meta.description: Premium dark UI trading and investment Webflow template for trading platforms, fintech startups, brokers, and financial businesses. Fully responsive, SEO-friendly, conversion-focused.

effects.glow: Blue/purple glows on hero 3D elements and cards
effects.shadows: Soft dark shadows, brand blue box-shadows on interactive elements
effects.borders: Subtle white/10 or brand blue borders on cards
effects.gradients: Blue radial and linear gradients for depth and CTAs

section.name: Navigation
section.description: Fixed/sticky top nav on dark background. Logo left (TradeNova with blue icon), center menu links (About us, Features, Pages dropdown, Pricing, Resources), right CTA buttons: primary blue "Contact Us" and secondary white arrow button.
section.responsive: Collapses to mobile menu (hamburger) on smaller screens. Full width padding.

section.name: Hero
section.description: Full viewport dark hero with geometric frame, central 3D blue pie-chart / candlestick / coin illustration with purple/blue glow and light rays. Large white/gradient heading "Unlock Smarter Trading with Powerful Market Tools". Subtext in muted gray. Dual CTAs: blue "Start Trading" + white arrow button. Bottom social proof: avatars + 4.9 Star Review + logo strip (Logoipsum placeholders).

element.text: Unlock Smarter Trading with Powerful Market Tools
element.style: large, white with blue accent on 'Trading'

element.text: A modern trading platform built to help you analyze markets, manage risk, and trade with confidence in real time.

element.description: 3D glassmorphism style pie chart with bars, coins, upward arrow, blue/purple neon glow

section.responsive: Stacks vertically on mobile, illustration scales down, text centers.

section.name: Brand / Social Proof
section.description: Centered 4.9 Star Review with avatar group and logo carousel/strip of partner logos (Logoipsum style).

section.name: Features
section.description: Heading "Everything You Need to Trade Effectively". Grid of feature cards (2-3 columns): Institutional Spreads No Commissions (with chart graphic), Multi-Market Access (circular icons), Portfolio Management, Advanced Charting Tools, Secure and direct market. Each card dark bg, subtle border, icon/illustration, title, description. Hover effects with glow.
section.layout: Responsive grid: 3-col desktop, 2-col tablet, 1-col mobile. Cards with rounded corners (~1rem+), padding, internal graphics (line charts, icons).

section.name: Steps
section.description: "Trading in 3 Simple Steps". Numbered or sequential steps with icons and descriptions.

section.name: Insights
section.description: "Built for Better Trading Decisions". Content blocks with visuals for analysis tools, charts, decisions.

section.name: Pricing
section.description: "Choose Your Capital and Start Trading Instantly". Pricing cards or capital selection UI, likely tiered plans with CTAs.

section.name: Footer
section.description: Standard multi-column footer with logo, links (About, Features, Pricing, Resources, Legal), social icons, copyright. Dark bg matching theme.

responsive_breakpoints.mobile: <768px : single column, stacked CTAs, hamburger nav, scaled illustrations

design_audit.recreation_notes: - Use Inter Display font (or Inter as fallback). - Primary accent #234eed throughout CTAs, links, highlights. - Backgrounds near-black #00020f / #0a0b1d. - Cards: dark glass or solid with subtle borders and blue glows on hover/focus. - 3D/hero illustrations: custom or stock 3D with blue neon lighting. - Animations: smooth fade-ins, subtle hover scales, Webflow interactions for scroll reveals. - Fully CMS ready for blog/insights. - To match exactly: inspect live site in browser DevTools for precise measurements, as this audit captures the system and structure.
